description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Restless Apparition
When Restless Apparition dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Restless Apparition enters, Stalwart Successor triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Restless Apparition
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.
